title: Apple Music Plans Selfie Sing Karaoke Feature
excerpt: Apple Music will introduce a new feature called Selfie Sing, allowing users to record themselves doing karaoke.
body_html:
Apple Music is preparing to launch a new feature called Selfie Sing, according to recent reports. The upcoming addition will allow users to record video of themselves while performing karaoke.

The feature is scheduled to arrive alongside the release of iOS 27.3. Further details regarding the exact functionality and tools included in the update have not yet been detailed.
